analyses.title: Archive import escapes the import folder (path traversal)

facts.exposure: The upload route is served on all interfaces by default (the app binds 0.0.0.0 unless HOST is set), so anyone who can reach the host's port can use it.
facts.identity: Any user who can reach the upload form.
facts.controls: None on the member path before the write.
facts.blind_spots: The deployment's network policy is not in the repository.

attacker_steps: Build a zip whose member name climbs out of the import folder.
Upload it through the import form.
The server writes the member outside the import folder.
analyses.dataflow: Uploaded archive -> member name -> path join -> file write outside the import folder.
analyses.reachability: Any user who can reach the form -> upload route -> no containment check -> arbitrary file write (reproduced twice in stage 3).

counterevidence.evidence: Checked for a reverse proxy, allowlist, or authentication in front of the upload route; none is configured in the repository.
No normalization or containment check runs before the write.

analyses.severity_rationale: Arbitrary file write on the server, reproduced; stage 1 lists file writes outside the data folder as High. Not critical: no code execution was shown.
analyses.change_conditions: Raise to critical if a written file is later executed or loaded as configuration; lower if uploads are restricted to trusted operators.

confidence.reason: Reproduced twice through the real upload interface with a passing control.

analyses.title: Admin routes without a role check

facts.exposure: Registered on the main router; whether a global hook guards it is not settled.
facts.identity: Any user who can reach the upload form.
facts.controls: None on the member path before the write.
facts.blind_spots: The deployment's network policy is not in the repository.

attacker_steps: Perform the admin action if no role check runs.
analyses.reachability: Normal user -> admin route -> no role decorator seen -> admin action (not reproduced).

counterevidence.evidence: No global before-request role hook was found, but the app's bootstrap could not be exercised.

analyses.severity_rationale: High impact if it holds; likelihood is unknown until a seeded admin session is tested, so the matrix gives a provisional medium.
analyses.change_conditions: Raise to high if a normal session reaches the admin action; ignore if a global role check is found.
analyses.proof_gap: Stage 3 could not seed an admin session, so the missing role check was not exercised at runtime.

confidence.reason: Static only; the runtime auth wiring was not exercised.

analyses.title: Error page shows a stack trace to the requesting user

facts.exposure: The upload route is served on the app's listener (`HOST` default).
facts.identity: Any user who can reach the upload form.
facts.impact_surface: The requesting user's own error page.
facts.controls: Errors are rendered only to the session that caused them.
facts.blind_spots: The deployment's network policy is not in the repository.

attacker_steps: Receive a stack trace in the response to that same request.
analyses.dataflow: Exception -> error handler -> response body of the same request.
analyses.reachability: Any user -> any route -> malformed input -> their own error page.

counterevidence.evidence: The handler writes the trace only to the response of the request that raised it; no log or page is shared with other users.

analyses.severity_rationale: Only the requester sees the trace; stage 1's calibration table lists self-only information disclosure as a counterexample for Low.
analyses.change_conditions: Raise it if traces reach logs or pages other users can read, or include secrets.

confidence.reason: Reproduced in stage 3; the handler's output path is fully visible.

not_eligible.reason: rejected in stage 3: the control held, so there is no attack path to rate

open_questions: Does any deployment set HOST beyond 127.0.0.1 for shared use?
